sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cymon is a hero of Welsh story. He holds a minor place in the tale of Owein. Owein is the hero who married the lady of the fountain. Cymon sets the quest in motion. He fights the black knight who is laying siege to the lady's domain, and he loses the fight. That defeat sends Owein toward the lady's land.

okr.objective: Cymon is a hero of Welsh story tied to the tale of Owein.
